title: I did a ‘cheap’ trick
author: jildos_legoplanet
selftext:
I saw a lot of these revamped classic games coming by here lately and for some reason, all those 90s style games gave me a craving again for BattleChess. So I (I mean Codex) made one: [https://sidesliders.itch.io/battlechess](https://sidesliders.itch.io/battlechess)

I was basically a single multi-agent prompt that I pointed to a repo with the original game in it. From there I had to fix a few ugly renders. 

From there I thought it would be great to add multiplayer option and AR, both worked! 

Especially the AR is a lot of fun playing with a friend on a physical table. Reminds me of holochess from Star Wars :)
